name: Shokushu Gakuen Tolanuru
source:
Tentacle monster assaults girls everywhere - in the bathroom, shower, gym even during summer festival. This is animated story about tentacle violation of four To Love-Ru heroines.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
触手怪物无处不在地袭击少女们——浴室、淋浴间、体育馆，甚至连热闹的夏日祭典也不放过。这是一部描绘《出包王女》四位女主角惨遭触手凌辱的动态视觉小说。
